newsitem.title: POLAND: OKOCIM, LUBUSZ BREWER CLASH OVER TRADEMARK.
newsitem.headline: OKOCIM, LUBUSZ BREWER CLASH OVER TRADEMARK.

text.p: Polish brewer Browary Zachodnie Lubusz SA demands that brewer Okocim SA stop selling its "Zagloba" brand beer and wants three million zlotys in damages for allegedly using its trademark, Okocim said on Thursday.
Lubusz claims it has been producing the beer since 1994.
Okocim said in a statement, however, that it started producing the beer in 1978 and in 1994 it applied to the patent office to register "Zagloba" as its own trademark.
Okocim said it also applied to the office in January to cancel Lubusz's right to the "Zagloba" trademark but the office had not made a decision. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
